name: WoofBot (without Lightning)
description: WoofBot is a chat bot that runs on your personal Bitcoin node and sends telegram notifications for configured events: payments from/to specified addresses, transactions being confirmed, new-blocks and more. This version of WoofBot requires only Bitcoin Core to be installed, and does not integrate with any lightning api.
short_desc: A chatbot for your personal node
author: WoofBotApp

form_fields.label: Container User (UID:GID)
form_fields.hint: Process user and group ID (UID:GID). Keep 1000:1000 unless custom host permissions are required.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a numeric UID:GID (e.g. 1000:1000) or numeric UID (e.g. 1000)

form_fields.label: Bitcoin Node Host / IP
form_fields.hint: Hostname or IP of your Bitcoin RPC node on the Runtipi network
